verdict_rationale: The required source change does not exist: no C1 commit (worktree clean at 2cee039f) and no O13 validator. In addition, new evidence shows the snap's premise is false. 19,195 of 22,588 connectors start on the inner border of their laneLink from-lane; 4,024 of 4,025 snap moves equal a cumulative incoming lane width. So the minimal source fix is to disable or lane-border-gate the snap, not to harden the Hermite refit.
